I've decided since Sunday is my rest day, why not start a weekly discussion thread for the exercises I did over the week.

Monday: Upper body focused movement, mostly in my chest and arms, and a half an hour working with a theraband.

Tuesday: short squats so my knees wouldn't buckle, lots of em all day.

Wednesday: took over 7000 steps while out about about according to pedometer, and did a number of sessions of holding my arms up and out for as long as I could.

Thursday: Situps, from a sitting reclined position. Came up with this from reading fat people can't sit up in dentists chairs. I might not be able to do much proper situps, but I can at least do that, and maybe it's a stage between where I am now and a situp.

Friday: 1.55 liter bottle filled and used for resistance in turning my torso. I would sit on the floor. Turn myself to pick up the bottle from my hip, turn to place it at my other hip, turn back forward, then repeat.

Saturday: same movement, but standing with no resistance, and a broom in my hands in a corner to ensure I can't turn to far (harder when I'm standing and my hips are free to shift.)

Most of the time, I don't work out with time limits though I do have a goal of around 2 hours a day, basically I just do a set whenever I feel strong enough to do it and I rest whenever I feel my control wavering. generally I'll do 15 to 200 reps a set depending on the physical action and how I'm feeling.
